t: You're at Brunswick Square, a three-acre public garden in Bloomsbury, in the King's Cross area of the London Borough of Camden. The School of Pharmacy and the Foundling Museum overlook it to the north, the Brunswick Centre lies to the west, and International Hall to the south. Charles Collett Shoppee, who lived from 1833 to 1912, was born here. He became an Anglo-Australian builder and politician.
